propositions: Plan-review and completion-verification gates must block when ticket descriptions exceed a configurable maximum (default 8,000 characters).
Descriptions of exactly 8,000 characters are admitted; 8,001+ characters trigger deterministic BLOCK/FAIL with zero LLM calls before any verification logic runs.
Light-bug-tier plan review retains the P4 description block in det_blocking while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory status.
P4 AC-count and file-impact signals remain advisory; only the description-size finding can be blocking at the configured threshold.

Completion verification checks the authoritative ticket description against the [verify] setting immediately after loading it and before child checks, returning a validated deterministic FAIL with an actionable finding and zero runner calls if oversized.
